the XTRP is an effective tool to select high momentum leptons and heavy flavor events in the CDF-II detector and that the design of the XSTRP is a good example of how to build a custom trigger system using discrete and FPGA technology.

the development of the XTRPs for the trigger system at the CDF-II detector.
the design, implementation and operation of the XTRPs.
the design and construction of a system that can efficiently select high-momentum lepton and heavy-flavor tracks in the CDF-II detector.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the XTRP is an effective system for the selection of high momentum tracks in the high rate environment of the CDF experiment and can be easily adapted to other high rate environments.
a custom FPGA-based design can be successfully used to implement a complex algorithm for a high-energy physics experiment.
